title: Authentication sources
subtitle: Manage Minecraft identity providers and their verification priority.
builtin_hint: Official accounts keep their original UUIDs. This source is always enabled and cannot be replaced or reordered.
priority_hint: Enabled sources are checked from top to bottom after Mojang.
tag_hint: A unique ID without colons or surrounding spaces. It becomes permanent when saved.
tag_locked: This ID is fixed to preserve player UUIDs and account links.
prefix_hint: 1–4 letters or digits, used when a player has an official account’s name.
url_hint: Use HTTPS. HTTP is allowed only for localhost or private IPs. Do not include a query or fragment.
api_hint: Leave empty for a standard hasJoined URL; otherwise provide the Yggdrasil API root for role lookup.
test_hint: Checks whether the login endpoint rejects an unused session correctly.
test_status: Endpoint returned HTTP {{status}}; expected 204 for an unused session.
empty: Only official accounts are enabled. Add a source to accept another provider.
disable_hint: Disable a saved source to stop accepting its logins. Its ID stays reserved so identities can be restored later. Launchers must use the same provider.
invalid: Check source IDs, unique prefixes and complete HTTP(S) addresses without queries or fragments.
unsaved: Unsaved changes · saving applies to the next login and role lookup
active: Saved sources are active; no restart is required.
defaults: Using installation defaults. Saved panel configuration takes precedence.
saved: Saved and active. New logins and role lookups use this configuration; online players stay connected.
